description: Source code for a tool named jboot_config_read, which reads and processes configuration data from a binary file, including parsing headers, verifying checksums, printing data, and extracting specific information like MAC addresses or EEPROM calibration data.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and options for the program.

methods.name: print_data_header
methods.description: Prints the details of a data header, including id, type, unknown, length, and data bytes.

methods.name: jboot_checksum
methods.description: Calculates a checksum over a data array, used for verifying headers.

methods.name: find_header
methods.description: Searches through a buffer to locate specific headers and populates a data table with found headers.

methods.name: read_file
methods.description: Reads a binary configuration file into memory buffer.

methods.name: write_file
methods.description: Writes data to a specified output file.

methods.name: print_mac
methods.description: Extracts and prints MAC address from data headers.

methods.name: write_eeprom
methods.description: Writes EEPROM calibration data to a file.
